acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing RPG World, you agree to comply with these terms. This software is provided by Rebs Tech Studio "as is", without warranties of any kind.

conduct.title: 2. User Conduct
conduct.content: RPG World is a space for creativity and fun. It is strictly prohibited:
items: Publishing content that promotes hate, racism, or any form of discrimination.
Using the system for spam or illegal activities.

content.title: 3. User Content
content.content: You retain ownership of all stories and characters created. However, by using our platform, you grant us a worldwide, royalty-free license to store and display this content solely for game operation.

donations.title: 4. Donations and "Buy me a coffee"
donations.content: Financial contributions are voluntary donations to support development. They do not constitute the purchase of services, do not grant ownership rights over the software, and are non-refundable.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: We are not responsible for data loss, connection errors, or service interruptions. As the code is open source (GPLv3), you have the right to host your own instance if you wish for full control over your data.

age.title: 6. Minimum Age and Child Protection
age.content: RPG World is intended for users who are at least 13 years old. We do not intentionally collect data from children under 13. If we become aware that a minor under 13 has provided us with personal data, we will take steps to delete such information and close the account.

updates.title: 7. Changes to the Terms
updates.content: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. We will notify users about significant changes through system notices or by email. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

law.title: 8. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
law.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. Any dispute will be resolved in the jurisdiction of the city of São José dos Campos, SP, with express waiver of any other.

gameContent.title: 9. Game Content and Credits
gameContent.content: The rules and spells shown in RPG World come from open sources, used under their licenses:
items: This work includes material taken from the <srd>System Reference Document 5.1</srd> ("SRD 5.1") by Wizards of the Coast LLC. The SRD 5.1 is licensed under the <ccby>Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License</ccby>.
The structured English spell data was obtained from the <api>5e SRD API</api>, from the <database>5e-bits/5e-database</database> project, under the MIT license.

The Brazilian Portuguese spell translations come from the <foundry>D&D 5e translation module for Foundry VTT</foundry> by the Foundry VTT Brasil community (Cauã Pessoa and contributors), under the MIT license.
RPG World is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Wizards of the Coast. Dungeons & Dragons and D&D are trademarks of Wizards of the Coast LLC.
Full credits and license texts are in the repository's <notice>NOTICE.md</notice> file.

data.title: 1. Data Collected
data.content: We collect only what is essential for your experience:
items: Account: email and password (the password is stored encrypted by <supabase>Supabase</supabase>) or, if you sign in with <google>Google</google>, the email and name of your Google account.
Profile: username, avatar and preferred color.
Characters: sheets, backstory, learned spells and the images you upload.
Support: email, type and message, when you use the contact form.

Technical data: when you visit the site, <vercel>Vercel</vercel> and <supabase>Supabase</supabase> log the IP address, browser and requested pages, for security and error diagnosis. On protected forms, <cloudflare>Cloudflare Turnstile</cloudflare> checks the IP and browser signals to tell people from bots. To count visits we use <cloudflare>Cloudflare Web Analytics</cloudflare>, which uses no cookies and does not identify you: it only records aggregate numbers, such as page views and load times.

usage.title: 2. Data Usage
usage.content: Your data is used exclusively to:
items: Keep you signed in and protect your account.
Save your characters and sync them across devices.
Send account emails (sign-up confirmation and password reset) and reply to your support messages.

sharing.title: 3. Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell your data to third parties. To run RPG World we use these services: <supabase>Supabase</supabase> (database, sign-in and image storage), <vercel>Vercel</vercel> (hosting), <resend>Resend</resend> (email delivery), <cloudflare>Cloudflare Turnstile</cloudflare> (bot protection on sign-up, the magic link, password reset and the contact form; and anonymous visit counts, with Cloudflare Web Analytics), <discord>Discord</discord> (where the support team receives the messages sent through the contact form: email, type, message and, if you are signed in, your account id) and <google>Google</google> (only if you sign in with Google). Today your characters and your profile are visible only to you; avatar images are stored at a public address that is not listed anywhere.

rights.title: 4. Your Rights
rights.content: In accordance with <lgpd>LGPD</lgpd>/GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your data. While the automatic deletion feature is under development, you can request the total deletion of your account and all associated data through our <server>Discord server</server>, telling us your account's email. We will process your request within 5 business days.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies
cookies.content: We only use necessary cookies: the ones for your sign-in session, the language you chose and your time zone. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

transfer.title: 6. International Data Transfer
transfer.content: To operate the system, we use third-party infrastructure (such as <supabase>Supabase</supabase>, <vercel>Vercel</vercel>, <resend>Resend</resend> and <discord>Discord</discord>). As a result, your data may be processed and stored on servers located outside of Brazil, specifically in the United States. By using RPG World, you consent to this international transfer, conducted under strict security and encryption standards.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention and Deletion
retention.content: Your data remains stored in our database as long as your account is active. If your account remains inactive for more than 24 months, we reserve the right to perform automatic deletion for security and resource saving.

contact.title: 8. Contact and Data Controller
contact.content: For any questions regarding your privacy or to exercise your rights (<lgpd>LGPD</lgpd>), talk to the team on our <server>Discord server</server>. For matters about your account, prefer a direct message to the team over the public channels.

seo.title: RPG World: free D&D 5e character sheets
seo.description: Free, open-source app to create and manage D&D 5e character sheets, with automatic calculations and an SRD spellbook, in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
seo.ogImageAlt: RPG World logo next to a D&D 5e character sheet and a glowing purple d20

features.highlightsSubtitle: The sheet does the math, the spellbook has the SRD spells and everything works in English and Portuguese.
features.metaDescription: Everything RPG World does today: a D&D 5e character sheet with automatic calculations, a searchable SRD spellbook, character lore and more, in English and Portuguese.
features.title: Everything you can do in RPG World
features.subtitle: Free, open source and no account needed to look around. Create one when you want to build your first character.
features.plannedSubtitle: What we are working on. Not available yet.

sheet.title: A full sheet on one page
sheet.description: Ability scores, saving throws, skills with proficiency and expertise, AC, initiative, speed and hit dice, all in view.
